tier_derivation: Held at the lowest non-promotable tier because the required authenticated UI, mobile, attachment, restore and host-session families are absent or blocked; no family is averaged away.

F1_source_identity.note: Immutable fork commit and git-archive digest recorded.

F2_source_rights.note: AGPL and Section 7 boundary observed; corresponding-source/product attestation remains blocked.

F4_dependency_closure.note: No independent transitive closure receipt captured by this package.

F5_ports_and_binding.note: Typed host seam and synthetic binding contract validate; donor session execution is not claimed.

F6_build_runtime.note: Historical pinned isolated build and backend health checks passed; this package does not rerun the donor.

F7_authenticated_workflow_ui.note: Native authenticated desktop and mobile CRUD are explicitly blocked in the exact receipt.

F8_persistence_and_tenancy.note: CRUD/reconnect and two-client denial passed in the candidate receipt, but the independent role/schema/restore boundary remains open in the isolation gate.

F9_files_recovery_and_admission.note: Attachment namespace, rollback/restore and direct-denial/admission evidence remain blocked.

receipts.expected: The package points at an immutable donor revision with a reproducible content digest.
receipts.observed: b245a987f8bfb7411d4e2423907b9cbb0a1c9b6b; sha256:e41fe62b54c1d0c077a9c5a036f1b4e04016dcd0203396f943411e89e6e09fc6 from a git archive tar stream.
receipts.falsifier: The revision cannot be resolved or the archive digest changes for the same commit.
receipts.limitations: The existing checkout is dirty; uncommitted files are excluded from this identity.

receipts.expected: One bounded reuse shape is explicit and does not copy donor source.
receipts.observed: intact_service + sidecar_service + host proxy; copied source files = 0.
receipts.falsifier: The package needs donor source edits or a new runtime profile to bind.
receipts.limitations: The host session exchange and proxy are interface-level only in this package.

receipts.expected: Pinned donor build/runtime and database-layer checks are represented without overstating UI proof.
receipts.observed: Historical receipt reports isolated build, backend health, table CRUD/persistence and two-client isolation as pass.
receipts.falsifier: The cited receipt is absent or its pass fields contradict the package summary.
receipts.limitations: No donor execution is performed by this package smoke; native authenticated desktop/mobile and attachment proof are not covered.

receipts.expected: Authenticated native desktop and mobile CRUD are proved before qualification or release.
receipts.observed: The exact receipt records authenticated-native-desktop-crud BLOCKED and authenticated-native-mobile-crud BLOCKED.
receipts.falsifier: A fresh reproducible authenticated proof session covers both surfaces and is appended to a new dossier.
receipts.limitations: This package must not use synthetic UI or the historical unauthenticated redirect as a substitute.

receipts.expected: Attachment reads/uploads are host-authorized, tenant/base namespaced and rollback-aware.
receipts.observed: The receipt records blob namespace BLOCKED because no native authenticated attachment upload proof exists; the donor uses signed URLs.
receipts.falsifier: An authenticated proof demonstrates upload, read authorization and cross-tenant denial for a namespaced object.
receipts.limitations: A signed URL alone is not host permission proof.

receipts.expected: Two clients are isolated and the module has independent role/schema/restore boundaries.
receipts.observed: Candidate receipt reports two-client row/DB isolation PASS; the isolation gate separately says the required per-client role/schema and independent restore boundary FAILS/does not close.
receipts.falsifier: A new exact-pin run proves least-privilege role/schema, Redis namespace, attachment namespace, backup/restore and second-client denial together.
receipts.limitations: The two historical artifacts are different scopes and must not be collapsed into a full admission pass.

receipts.expected: Manifest, records, config, typed binding shape and scoped theme bridge pass deterministic local checks.
receipts.observed: Package smoke runs green: 13 checks PASS, exit 0, with no network and no donor execution. Includes 3 fail-closed negative fixtures (missing_or_unverified_identity, missing_tenant, missing_migration_owner), each of which must REFUSE for the run to pass.
receipts.falsifier: The package CLI reports a contract, link, refusal or theme-scope failure.
receipts.limitations: A package smoke cannot qualify the donor runtime or grant admission. It proves the contract surface only: manifest, records, config, binding shape, theme scope and the refusal paths. The authenticated UI, mobile, attachment, isolation and Section 7 holds are untouched by it.

receipts.expected: No release/admission is claimed from this prototype.
receipts.observed: Registry and release records are held/not_released; admission_scope is empty for tenants and applications.
receipts.falsifier: Any artifact or message asserts production qualification/admission.
receipts.limitations: The next proof requires operator/experiment decisions outside this package.

hold_reasons: host identity/session handoff not reproduced here
AGPL corresponding-source and Section 7 attestation gate remains blocked
